verdict.rationale: The only guided first-run material is a developer quickstart: create a personal access token, make a first API request, and see a new page appear in your workspace in under two minutes. The llms.txt index also lists a 'Get started' overview. Both are walkthroughs for API and connection setup, not a guided walkthrough for setting up the workspace itself. Missing for 10: an onboarding flow or tutorial for first-time workspace setup (structure, pages, teamspaces, settings), engineer-specific setup guidance, and any hands-on or community confirmation of the onboarding experience.
